title: Aayein?!
blurb: Disbelief, offence and a demand for immediate explanation, all compressed into a single nasal syllable. Paresh Rawal's delivery is what makes it — the timing is perfect, the confusion is total, and it lands somewhere between a question and an accusation. It functions as the desi internet's version of 'I beg your pardon', deployed at nonsense of any origin whatsoever. It has become one of the great reaction sounds of the Indian meme renaissance, quoted by people who have never seen the film and would not recognise the actor. Aayein?!
origin: Paresh Rawal's iconic confused exclamation from Indian cinema, meme-ified.
